licence.scope: NASA science data licence (owner's data terms, step 2); same statement and class as Cassini__ISS_NAC and Dawn__FC. It covers calibration data from NASA-led missions unless a file carries a restrictive notice; the licence page does not name Voyager or the filter curves. info.json gives no page URL, only the cited reference Smith et al. 1977 (bibcode 1977SSRv...21..103S). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: NASA should be acknowledged as the source of the material.
